$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-recurring pack composed with the Fresh Cut lawn-care content seed, pinned to the gameday register with its own brand, appearance, nav, and pages. Everything else — sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Lawn care & mowing
description: An Atlanta lawn crew's site in a sportswear-campaign register: white condensed block type over a striped-lawn photograph, plans printed as season tickets with perforated stubs and barcodes, the season as a photo rail, a what's-in-a-cut checklist, neighborhood testimonials, and a booking form that asks for the grass, the gate, and the rhythm — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this trade's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Yard walk & quote
types.description: We walk the yard with you, name the grass, set the blade height, and quote the plan on the spot.

types.name: First cut
types.description: Your first full cut: mow, edge, trim, blow, and stripe — with the after photo from the curb.

theme.$comment: The gameday register's brand overlay: stadium green on the light appearance and volt on the dark — the one accent a sportswear drop runs, on the striped-lawn ground. mode pins the dark appearance the campaign was designed in (the ground IS the lawn). navigation re-pins the shared servicesRecurringShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop) to the full-width bar — the scoreboard rail across the top — distinct from the base cleaner's split bar and the pest remix's inline card.

landing.$comment: Pins this remix's look. resolveCatalog merges a remix's landing shallowly over the base's, so this style and these pages replace the base pack's. The preset is gameday (striped-lawn ground, Barlow Condensed block caps leaning italic, one volt accent, the sport treatment). The pages are what the builders emit from this seed's content: the hero full-bleed (home.layout), the plans as tickets (every plan carries a stub), the season on the steps rail, what's in a cut on the checklist. Routes stay the base's.
